frequency_question: How often can a central bank formulate, test systems for, and officially notify a reserve requirement adjustment within a window of 90 days or less?
membership_rule: Includes any formal policy rate or reserve ratio adjustment implemented by major central banks or the RBI where the time from initial internal policy formulation to public notification was measured.
provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 4 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 4 named instances of rapid reserve ratio deployment; all successfully executed within days of decision.
known_gaps: Limited to standard regulatory notice periods for liquidity measures.
skeleton: RBI policy circulars and reserve ratio adjustments executed via notification with immediate or near-term effect over the last 15 years.
multiplier: 4 observed rapid implementation events / 4 total attempted rapid implementations within the target operational window.
validity_reason: Central bank regulatory notification frameworks and IT core banking interfaces for reserve computations change slowly.
